Numbers are assigned in the order a capability was FIRST started, never reused or reordered — jumping ahead to build #14 while #10/#11 stay paused is expected and fine; this file is exactly what lets any future session (human or AI) resume the paused ones without re-deriving context. Different from registry/capability-registry.json (an auto-generated, frozen, per-function inventory) — this is a human-scale roadmap of real feature areas, hand-maintained. Per Rule 112, this lives in registry/ (not any one AI's own memory) so any AI reading it later gets the same picture.

capabilities.name: Reverse-match against real bank STATEMENT (incoming customer payments)
capabilities.done: Real trace of a live case (บจก. เคที คอนสตรัคชั่น 1988, 5,000 บาท, TRBS260723374064276) found a permanent structural gap in #15/#16: a bank's transfer-confirmation EMAIL always goes to whoever INITIATED the transfer, never the recipient — so bankEmailVerified can never be satisfied by a real incoming customer payment, only by the owner's own outgoing transactions. The real independent second source for incoming money is the bank's own STATEMENT (bank_statement_transactions, #10). New edge function supabase/functions/bank-statement-reconcile does the same reverse-match as #16 but against real statement rows: for every pending receipt_documents claim (payment_advice/transfer_slip, status ai_read) whose amount+calendar date match a real 'รับโอนเงิน'/'ฝากเงินสด' row, completes the same real downstream chain (reconcile_receipt_payment() via tryAutoConfirmPayment, or the order-dispatch gate) — never guesses when ambiguous (>1 same-day-same-amount statement row is explicitly left for a human). scripts/bank-statement-sync/index.mjs now calls this endpoint automatically right after every real sync. Live-tested against the real 396-document backlog: 0 false-positive confirmations, 384 skipped for bad/missing dates (pre-existing OCR date-misread issue, not this function's bug), 12 correctly found no match yet (statement data only covers May-June so far).

capabilities.name: Local Event Buffer (Non-Blocking webhook save, DB-down resilience)
capabilities.done: Real gap found live 2026-07-30 (during the local-migration effort — DB briefly unreachable is a real, not hypothetical, condition now): events/store.ts's saveEvent() — 'the single save point, every handler calls it, never writes to line_events directly' — silently returned null on any DB error, and every handler (handlers/image.ts, handlers/text.ts, etc.) just gave up entirely: no reply sent, nothing recorded, the customer's message gone. New engines/local-event-buffer.ts (file-based, not in-memory-only, so a Deno edge-runtime restart between requests can't lose it) — on insert failure, the event is appended to a local JSONL file instead of dropped, saveEvent() returns { id: bufferedId, buffered: true } instead of null. flushBufferedEvents() drains the file back into the real table, called opportunistically at the start of every new saveEvent() (so recovery doesn't need a human to notice) and removes the buffer file entirely once fully drained (owner's own instruction: 'ลบ Cache/Buffer ชั่วคราวออกทันที เพื่อคืน Memory'). The webhook idempotency dup-check is also now resilient to DB-down (treated as 'not a known duplicate' rather than failing the request).
capabilities.missing: Honest scope limit: only the SAVE step is now non-blocking against DB failure. Downstream handlers (handlers/image.ts and friends) still assume saved.id is a REAL line_events row id for further writes (media_path update, classification results referencing line_event_id) — when buffered, that id is a synthetic 'buffered:<uuid>' string, so those specific downstream writes would still fail today (though the core message/event itself is no longer lost). Each handler needs individual hardening to skip/defer its own DB-dependent steps when saved.buffered===true, and no dedicated flush cron exists yet (only the opportunistic per-request flush) — a real idle-recovery cron (same pattern as bank-email-sync/receipt-reconcile-sweep) would close that gap. Also out of scope so far: the broader 'Decoupled Output' ask (fire-and-forget writes even when DB is merely slow, not failing) — this only covers the DB-down case, not DB-slow.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Ground-Truth Layer for cognitive/pipeline.ts (owner's "Event-Driven Cascade" framing)
capabilities.done: Owner framing 2026-07-30: source code must resolve every fact/business-object to 100% ground truth BEFORE the LLM ever sees a question — the LLM is only the 'final perception stage', never the one filling gaps with guesses. Real bugs found live and fixed in this session against that standard: (1) `enrichWithTranslator()` (cognitive/pipeline.ts) had an inverted guard — treated 'no matched action' as 'what is empty' and discarded a correct full sentence ('ทรายหยาบกับทรายละเอียด') in favor of a single extracted noun ('ทราย') from services/ai/translator.ts (newly wired in same session, previously orphaned/unused — confirmed via grep, zero importers). Fixed: only fills `what` when genuinely null, never overrides. (2) `services/ai/translator.ts`'s `extractProduct()` didn't recognize fuel (น้ำมัน/ดีเซล/เบนซิน) as a product at all — owner correction: 'ทำไมมึงไม่ทำให้มันรู้จักราคาน้ำมัน...เมื่อไหร่ระบบมันจะคุยกันรู้เรื่อง' — added fuel keywords to the SAME product-recognition list construction materials already use, one shared taxonomy instead of two silos (price computation still correctly stays on two separate real engines — Bangchak live API vs pit_materials/quote-price.ts — since the underlying data sources are genuinely different). (3) `cognitive/reasoning/engine.ts` and `cognitive/objective/manager.ts` each independently duplicate a Thai VOCABULARY dictionary + substring-scan loop (known architectural debt, not yet unified into one shared module) — both had the identical blind-substring bug: "พนักงาน" (employee) contains "งาน" (job) as a literal substring, so asking about company staff got misrouted into a 'view job' workflow. Fixed identically in both via a negative-lookbehind guard for this specific known false positive (not general Thai word-segmentation — that's a bigger, separate problem). (4) `cognitive/reasoning/engine.ts` leaked its own internal English dictionary keys ("material", "job") straight into user-facing Thai sentences (`ดู${domainObj.type}ทั้งหมด` → "ดูmaterialทั้งหมด") — added a real `DOMAIN_TH` Thai-label lookup and routed every decision-string template through it. (5) A real, working material-price engine (engines/material-resolver.ts + engines/quote-price.ts, dispatcher command "material.quote") existed but was never reachable from the admin secretary chat's pipeline — `review_material` always defaulted to `material.list` (show everything) even for real price questions. Added a `PRICE_QUESTION_PATTERN` check that routes to the real `material.quote` command instead, with correct args verified by reading the dispatcher's actual implementation (`raw_input`/`quantity`/`customer_id` — not guessed). (6) Found while wiring #5: even a correctly-routed `material.quote` result never reached the user — `cognitive/board/index.ts` always displayed the generic `reflectionOutput.summary` ("...สำเร็จ (1 steps)") instead of the tool's own real returned data. Added explicit handling in composeBoard() for this one tool's result shape (matched/unmatched/no_gps/no_customer_id/full price), so the real computed number now actually shows in the chat. (7) Real AI hallucination found on TWO ungrounded business-capability questions ("มีบริการให้เช่าเครื่องจักรไหม" got a confident false denial; "ขอเบอร์โทร" got an invented LINE-only policy) — added an explicit prohibition to answerWithAi()'s system prompt (same proven-safe pattern as the LINE side's thoughtful-fallback.ts) forbidding the LLM from asserting/denying any business fact not in its given real context.
capabilities.missing: The VOCABULARY/substring-scan duplication between cognitive/reasoning/engine.ts and cognitive/objective/manager.ts is patched identically in both but still architecturally duplicated (Rule 101/103 debt) — a real future fix would unify them into one shared module both files import, rather than two copies that can silently drift apart again. The negative-lookbehind fix only covers the ONE false positive actually observed live ("พนักงาน"/"งาน") — other short vocabulary words (e.g. "รถ"→job, "คิว"→material) likely have similar unaudited false-positive risk inside longer real words, not yet swept for systematically. `material.quote`'s honest "no_gps"/"no_customer_id" outcomes mean the admin secretary chat (which usually has no active customer session) will often show a partial answer (material recognized, no price) rather than a full number — that's correct/honest behavior given the tool's real contract, not a bug, but worth knowing before expecting a number every time. Also fixed same day: an identity-collision bug (the local Ollama model's own baked Modelfile persona name "ธวัชชัย" turned out to be the owner's real name too — a genuine coincidence revealed live) plus the admin chat's Ollama call folding its system prompt into `prompt` instead of the dedicated `system` field (meaning it never actually overrode the model's own baked identity) — fixed the API call shape and added explicit gender-consistency ("ครับ" only) + name-disambiguation rules. And KM-008 (see existence.json): the SAME 'stale conversation-state hijacks a newer, different conversation' bug found and fixed in event-followup.ts was found AGAIN, unfixed, in debt-followup.ts by a full-codebase audit (Explore agent) — fixed with the identical newerEvent guard; supplier-quote-reply.ts has a related but distinct variant (concurrent multi-material RFQs to one pit) not yet fixed, needs the owner to confirm it's a real scenario first.

capabilities.name: Two-Brain Unification — LINE (Deno/cloud) + Admin (Next.js/owner's Mac)
capabilities.done: Owner demand 2026-07-30: "รวบสมองเข้าด้วยกัน ไม่ต้องแยกสองสมอง...ให้เหตุการณ์มันเป็นเรื่องเดียวกัน" — investigated and confirmed the system genuinely has 2 separate AI-response systems that never shared context: (1) cognitive/pipeline.ts (Next.js, runs only on the owner's own Mac via Tauri) powering the admin secretary chat + the per-customer "ถาม AI" button, and (2) supabase/functions/line-webhook-v2 + ~/dna-os-ollama/ai-task-watcher.mjs (Deno edge function in Supabase's cloud + a separate local script) powering real LINE customer auto-replies — different runtime, different codebase, different prompts, zero shared understanding, confirmed by direct code reading not assumption. HARD CONSTRAINT verified (not assumed): the two literally cannot reach each other over HTTP — the LINE webhook runs in Supabase's cloud, the admin app has no public URL (checked .env.local directly, none exists) since it only runs on the owner's laptop. Real, achievable fix delivered given that constraint: new supabase/functions/line-webhook-v2/engines/external-facts.ts — a Deno-compatible mirror of cognitive/pipeline.ts's answerExternalFact() (fuel price/weather/date) that calls the SAME real external sources (Bangchak, Open-Meteo, system clock) directly, wired into handlers/text.ts before tryCompleteAwaitingEvent (so a LINE customer asking about fuel/weather/date gets the same real grounded answer the admin side gets, never the local Ollama model guessing) — both sides now give IDENTICAL answers because they ask the same real ground truth, even though the fetching code exists in two files (necessary given the runtime split, same documented pattern as auto-build-event.ts's own duplication rationale). Also delivered same day: real 'open/switch screen by command' capability — a pre-existing but completely unused mechanism (app/api/command/route.ts + services/supabase/state-cache.ts, confirmed zero real UI consumers via grep) replaced with a direct fix: cognitive/board/index.ts's composeBoard() now derives a real `navigate_url` from the same resolved entities it already computes (customer→/admin/relationships, job→/admin/jobs, material→/admin/pits, debt→/admin/debt-tracking, partner→/admin/partners, document→/admin/receipts), and components/admin/SecretaryChat.tsx calls router.push() when present — so asking the secretary chat about a job/material/debt/etc. now actually navigates to the real matching admin page.
capabilities.missing: Full unification (the two sides sharing actual conversational/business-object understanding, not just the 4 external-fact types) is NOT done and, given the verified network-topology constraint, cannot be done via direct API calls between the two — would need either migrating the LINE webhook off Supabase Edge Functions onto something reachable by the admin app (a real infra migration), or exposing a public URL for the admin app (the owner explicitly moved away from public hosting like Vercel earlier this project, so this is in tension with an existing decision), or continuing the 'both sides call the same real ground truth' pattern for more fact types as they come up. Also not done: routing owner-facing anomaly/payment-approval alerts (currently only pushed to the owner's real LINE app via engines/owner-dispatcher.ts) into the SAME secretary chat window the owner actually has open and was testing all session — that requires a real-time push mechanism into an already-open browser session (e.g. a Supabase Realtime subscription, same pattern already used by app/admin/telemetry/page.tsx for ai_tasks) which doesn't exist for SecretaryChat.tsx yet; not started this session, a real next step given the owner explicitly asked for uncertain-payment items to land in this specific chat.

capabilities.name: Voice Wake Watcher — real fix: Node lacked microphone entitlement (root-caused via tccd system log) + bring-window-to-front on wake
capabilities.done: Live-debugged with the owner across several rounds after #33 shipped but produced zero detections. Diagnostic path, each step verified with a real command/output rather than guessed: (1) confirmed the launchd daemon was actually running (real PID via `launchctl list`). (2) confirmed via `sox ... -n stat` that a real, tiny (near-silent) signal WAS reaching the recording, ruling out a flat mic-blocked scenario at first glance. (3) Had the owner speak louder/closer — real amplitude 0.87 this time, and whisper-cli actually transcribed something, but consistently wrong: "ธวัชชัย" kept coming out as "ธอบัจใจ" (same wrong output 3x in a row — a real, systematic Whisper mis-hearing of this specific proper noun, not noise). Fixed with whisper-cli's own `--prompt "ธวัชชัย"` initial-context flag — verified live, side-by-side, on the exact same recording: instantly correct. (4) Even with that fix, the actual 24/7 daemon (Node spawning sox as a child) still produced zero detections — root-caused via `log show --predicate 'subsystem == "com.apple.TCC"'` (the real macOS privacy-daemon log, not guessed): "Prompting policy for hardened runtime; service: kTCCServiceMicrophone requires entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input but it is missing for responsible={...node...}" — Homebrew's node binary lacks this entitlement, so macOS silently and permanently denies microphone access to anything it spawns, with NO permission prompt ever shown at all (this is why the earlier interactive `rec` test via Terminal worked but the Node-driven daemon never could — different responsible process). Real fix: restructured so a plain bash script (~/dna-os-ollama/voice-wake-watcher.sh, launchd's direct ProgramArguments[0] now) owns the actual `rec`/whisper-cli calls — bash is grantable real TCC microphone permission, unlike the unsigned Homebrew node binary. A tiny new ~/dna-os-ollama/report-wake.mjs is invoked by the shell script ONLY after a wake word is already confirmed, purely to do the Supabase insert (no mic access needed there). Verified end-to-end live: log showed 'wake word detected: "ธวัชชัย"' and a real matching row landed in voice_wake_events. Separately, the owner then pointed out the widget wasn't visible when another app had focus (e.g. listening to music) — real gap: VoiceStandbyWidget.tsx lived inside the DNA OS window, which sits behind whatever app is in front; the mic-detection itself already worked regardless of focus, but the VISUAL response didn't surface. Fixed: on a wake event, the widget now calls a real Tauri window show()+unminimize()+setFocus() sequence (new core:window:allow-unminimize/allow-set-focus capabilities added to src-tauri/capabilities/default.json) to bring the actual window to the front, the same way Siri's own overlay raises above whatever app is active. Also changed the spoken acknowledgment from a bare "ครับเฮีย" to "ครับเฮีย ให้ผมช่วยอะไรครับ" per the owner's point that it should sound like it's actually waiting for a command, not just a name-echo. tsc/build clean; Tauri .app rebuilt (capability config changed) — owner needs to replace/relaunch the running .app with the freshly built one to get the new window-focus behavior.
capabilities.missing: Not yet re-verified live whether the window-focus fix actually raises the DNA OS window above another focused app in practice (the mic-detection + DB-insert half was re-verified live; the bring-to-front half was built and typechecked/built clean but not yet observed working with a real focus-stealing test). While searching for a real Supabase billing email to build the parser against (never guessed the format), found something more urgent: a genuine unpaid invoice (STUIEQ-00006, $39.51) had caused the real DNA OS Supabase org to be downgraded/paused for non-payment on 2026-07-29 — verified current status is ACTIVE_HEALTHY now (already resolved before this session touched it), and a separate real 'table publicly accessible' security-advisor email turned out to only reference spatial_ref_sys, an already-known/accepted Supabase-platform RLS limitation (verified live via `select tablename from pg_tables where rowsecurity=false`, not guessed) — reported both to the owner before continuing. Built entirely by REUSING the existing partner-payable cascade (engines/owner-dispatcher.ts, capability #18) instead of a second parallel notify/approve/match system, since partner_company_id/partner_line_user_id are both genuinely nullable there (verified by reading the migration first): (1) new table supabase_billing_events (dedup via gmail_message_id, same real pattern as bank_notifications). (2) new edge function supabase-billing-sync — same Gmail OAuth read-only pattern as bank-email-sync, parses the real email format confirmed live ('outstanding invoice STUIEQ-00006 with $39.51'), converts USD→THB via a Deno-side mirror of engines/bot-exchange-rate.ts's real BOT API call (same key, now also set as a Supabase secret), calls the existing requestPartnerPayableApproval() to push the real LINE approve-request to the owner. Live-tested against the real email: correctly parsed $39.51 → ฿1,325.83 at the real BOT rate 33.5567, inserted, notified. Cron every 30 min (pg_cron, real per-function secret). (3) owner-dispatcher.ts's matchOwnerSlipToPartnerPayable() (already the real trigger for 'owner sends a slip after approving') now also inserts into company_expenses on match and closes the linked supabase_billing_events row — closing the exact loop the owner described (approve → transfer → send slip → recorded as a real expense). (4) Real notification badge: new app/api/admin/finance-alerts/route.ts (counts real partner_payable_requests still pending/owner_acknowledged) wired into the SAME real IconRail badge mechanism already used for the pits/pending-quotes badge (app/admin/relationships/workspace.tsx) — polls every 30s, same pattern, not a new alert system.
